name: wildfireInlineMlEnabled
definition: Every enabled allow rule carries an Antivirus profile whose file-based ML engine action is enable (not alert-only or disable), directly or through a profile group.
population: enabled allow rules in the rulebase of the vsys read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the security rulebase, profile groups and Antivirus profiles showing every enabled allow rule carrying an Antivirus profile whose file-based ML engine action is enable.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: Antivirus profile element names (profiles/virus/entry/mlav-engine-filebased-enabled/entry/mlav-policy-action with enable, alert-only or disable) are from the CLI hierarchy and UNVERIFIED on a real device. A profile name that is not in the profile reads (for example a predefined one) is unknown, so the key is Not evaluated. Cloud-delivered inline analysis settings are not read. vsys1 only.
